# Scutum

Scutum is a self-hosted LLM control plane. It sits between your applications
and every LLM provider you use — OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, Mistral,
Cohere, xAI, DeepSeek, plus self-hosted models via Ollama and vLLM — and
exposes them all through one OpenAI-compatible HTTP endpoint. Postgres is
the source of truth for routing, budgets, audit, policy, and team
membership; nothing about your usage ever leaves the infrastructure you
deploy on.

## What problem it solves

Teams that handle proprietary code, customer data, regulated workflows, or
revenue-sensitive prompts cannot route every LLM call through a vendor's
cloud (Portkey, Helicone, OpenRouter, Braintrust, Langfuse). They need the
same control-plane capabilities those products provide — cost prediction,
multi-team budgets, fallback chains, semantic caching, audit logs, DLP
scanning, A/B traffic splits, SSO/OIDC/SAML, fine-grained authorization
policies — but running on their own infrastructure with their own license
verification. Scutum is that control plane.

## How it works

Customers install Scutum with a single shell command:
`curl -fsSL https://scutum.dev/install.sh | sh`. The installer runs Docker
or Podman, fetches the release-tagged compose file, generates fresh
secrets, and drops a `scutum` operator CLI. Postgres holds all
configuration; the LiteLLM core proxy and Agent Gateway file-watch a YAML
materialised from Postgres by an admin API. License verification is
offline (Ed25519 JWTs validated against a public key bundled in the
admin-api image), so air-gapped deployments work without phone-home.

## chat.scutum.dev

chat.scutum.dev is a public AI search product built on Scutum. It looks
like Perplexity, but the difference is in the answer: instead of returning
prose, it returns interactive React components — calculators, charts,
comparison tables, decision trees, mini-explorers — rendered live in the
browser with sources cited inline as `[^N]` markers. Every query is routed
through the underlying Scutum gateway, every model is configurable, and the
search backbone is hybrid (Tavily + Brave deduped). It's free to use, no
signup, rate-limited at the Cloudflare edge.

## Relationship between the two

scutum.dev is the product (the self-hosted control plane). chat.scutum.dev
is a public demo of what Scutum makes possible — same gateway, same audit
log, same model-routing primitives, exposed through a chat interface that
anyone can try without installing anything. Teams who like chat.scutum.dev
can run their own copy on top of their own Scutum deployment.

## Where to start

- Marketing site and install: https://scutum.dev
- Chat product: https://chat.scutum.dev
- Documentation: https://scutum.dev/docs/
- Trial signup: https://scutum.dev/try/

## What Scutum is not

Not a vendor cloud. Not a managed service. Not open source. Not an LLM
fine-tuning platform. Not a SaaS observability tool with an "on-prem
option" that's really just a remote-tunnel to vendor infrastructure.
Scutum runs entirely on infrastructure the customer controls, under a
license they own.
